reason: Narrow is a degree word. The shape is still oblong.
Pliable means bendable, which is PATO flexible.
Chlorophyllose means containing chlorophyll, so green.
Hardly visible means inconspicuous.
Hornless means not horned. I could not read the FLOPO_0991029 row in the value-term file, so I did not check its definition.
Crimped means finely wavy or curled, which fits crisped.
Salient means standing out, which is prominent.
Fistulous means hollow, like a pipe.
Equal in size matches the definition of the FLOPO equal class, which is a size quality of a set of like parts.

The target 'floating' means resting on the water surface. Free-floating also means not attached to the ground, and it can mean submerged. The class's own note says free-floating plants must be kept apart from floating organs.
Cuculliform means hood-shaped, which is cucullate.
Inequal is a variant spelling of unequal.
Venate means having veins. PO vascular bundle has the synonym vein.
Cernuous means nodding or drooping.
Apiculate is a short, sharp, flexible tip. Mucronulate is a small stiff mucro. They are close but not the same, and the extra word 'short' is lost.
Samaroid means like a samara, a winged fruit, so winged.
PO primary root has the synonym tap root.
Narrow-ovate is ovate with a degree word. The target is the temporary ovate class.
Agglutinated means glued together without fusion, which matches coherent.
Barbulate means minutely bearded, which fits bearded. The small size is lost.
Pedately divided means pedate.
Loculicidally dehiscent means loculicidal.
Adhering means sticking to another structure, which matches adherent.
PATO falciform lists hooked as a synonym, so 'not hooked' maps to not falciform.
Rootless means root absent.
The rule negates the anastomosing value, which is the right meaning.
Soft-wooded describes the wood, not the whole bearer. Mapping it to plain 'soft' loses the wood. The bearer should be wood.
Spur-like means spur shaped.
Tape-like means strap-shaped.
Unpleasant alone can describe smell or taste. It is foetid only when the description is about smell.
Dichotomously forked means bifurcated. The word 'dichotomously' is lost but the meaning holds.
PATO falciform lists hooked as a synonym.
The quality 'inconspicuous' belongs to the veins, not to the bearer. The bearer should be vein, or the rule should be limited to veined parts.
Clawlike means claw-shaped.
Subrotund means nearly round, which is subcircular.
Hood-like means cucullate.
Exarillate means without an aril.
Stringy means fibrous in texture.
Tuberiferous means bearing tubers.
Upswept means curving upward, which is ascending.
Without lenticels means lenticel absent.
The subglabrous definition is 'nearly glabrous'.
Elongating in fruit means the part keeps growing after flowering, which is accrescent. The part constraint is sensible.
Not projecting means not protruding.
Partitioned means divided by septa, so septum present.
Strap-like means strap-shaped.
Conglomerate means clustered, and PATO aggregated lists clustered as a synonym.
Subrotundate is a variant of subrotund, which is subcircular.
Keel-like means keel-shaped.
Not keeled is the negation of keel-shaped.
